summary: Added a measured non-production Playwright performance matrix for representative public SSR routes. The matrix verifies SSR status and route markers, hydration shell visibility, navigation timing budgets, JavaScript and stylesheet transfer budgets, image completeness, locale direction, and route identity across Arabic, English, and Simplified Chinese Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile projects.

verification.notes: 18 performance cases passed. Maximum observed TTFB was 7 ms, DOMContentLoaded was 601 ms, load event was 1,220 ms, JavaScript was 1,497,908 bytes, and stylesheets were 434,343 bytes or less. Both public routes rendered complete images and correct locale, direction, and SSR route markers.
Web tests passed: 55 Vitest files / 315 tests plus the Node suite with 76 passing tests.
Web client and SSR production builds passed; the existing large-chunk warning remained non-fatal.
Root contracts, API, and Web typechecks passed.
Root aggregate tests passed: 507 API tests and the Web Vitest/Node suites passed.
Root contracts, API, and Web production builds passed; the existing large-chunk warning remained non-fatal.
72 visual tests passed across the configured browser matrix.
81 accessibility tests passed across the configured browser matrix.
No high-severity dependency vulnerabilities were reported; audit reported 0 vulnerabilities.
